newsitem.title: USA: Katz Digital ends talks with Boris Image.
newsitem.headline: Katz Digital ends talks with Boris Image.

text.p: Katz Digital Technologies Inc said on Friday it terminated acquisition talks with Boston-based Boris Image Group Inc.

Gary Katz, chief executive officer of Katz Digital said: "Although we are disappointed with our inability to come to terms with Boris Image, we still believe that the New England area presents good opportunities for expansion and we will continue to seek other acquisition candidates in that area."
Katz Digital Technologies provides digital printing and digital pre-press services.
